summary: 100-foot Aermotor in Montgomery County, MS; NHLR-registered July 2022 as US 1664, MS 29. Register says the MFC has left the site and it may now be timber-owned.

facts.design: 100-foot Aermotor with a straight internal staircase
facts.status_note: Last register site visit (July 9, 2022) describes the tower. The register says the site was vacated by the MFC; its condition since then is not documented.
facts.agency: Mississippi Forestry Commission (named in register; site reportedly vacated)

corrections.why: Spelling. The register repeats an extra 's' in 'Commisssion'; the commission's own site spells it 'Mississippi Forestry Commission'.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register names the MFC as administrator, but its own note says the MFC vacated the site and it may now be timber-owned. Both are reported; current ownership is not settled.

notes_for_editor: Only the NHLR detail page and the MFC homepage were read. Two searches found nothing on the tower's ownership change, and the Wikipedia article for Poplar Creek only repeats that the tower is on the register. The status 'standing' rests on the 2022 site-visit description, with no current condition source. Access is omitted because ownership is uncertain. The vacating and timber-company line is the register writer's note, not a confirmed record, so verify with MFC records or the Montgomery County board before relying on it.
